messages:
maya: Heads up - OpalNova renewal flagged. Their p95 jumped to ~250ms during peak; CS worried about retention.
leo: Any idea compute vs queue?
harper: Traces show queueing due to long sessions + frequent cache invalidations. They're on a 30B fp16 endpoint with no quant.
maya: My suggested play: 1) canary a 30B-int8 on dedicated for priority traffic, 2) add a hosted compact-6b fallback for bursty requests, 3) prefer-dedicated routing during 9-5 PT.
leo: Sounds good. Canary split: 4% int8 (dedicated), 6% compact-6b hosted fallback. Monitor regen-quality, latency, and token-cost delta.
harper: ML notes: need attention-kernel tune for seq_len=1800 and enable KV-prefetch on canary nodes. Also run regen eval on their prompt corpus.
maya: Can you drop an eval snippet and a short A/B script for CS? We need numbers for the renewal deck.
harper: Snippet: ```json
{"canary": {"percent": 4}, "models": [{"name": "opalnova-30b-int8","route": "dedicated-usw"}, {"name": "opalnova-6b-compact","route": "hosted-fallback"}]}
```
leo: Cost/back-of-envelope?
harper: int8 ~35% token cost reduction vs fp16. 6b compact ~70% on fallback traffic. Expect int8 compute +10-20ms for short seqs but overall p95 improves due to lower queuing.
maya: I'll assemble enablement playbook, request logging of prompt_id+eval_id to auto-flag regressions, and set a canary window next Thu 8-10am PT.
ops-bot: Reminder: create ticket CS-9317 for canary rollout and link ML-EVAL-734.
maya: tagging @harper @leo — Harper pls post eval artifacts and checklist by EOD. This should give OpalNova a clear cost/latency path before renewal.
